full_judgment: 6. There is a long standing practice that a revisional application is to be filed within the period of 90 days prescribed by law for appeal and that this Court may in its discretion entertain an application made for condo nation of delay in a suitable case where there is no negligence or laches on the part of the petitioner. The long standing practice does not call for any departure. The submissions made by the learned advocate for the petitioner and statements made in the application for condo nation of delay are sufficient. The petitioner fulfills the requirement under section 5 of the Limitation Act. Since the explanation for condo nation of delay is satisfactory, I am inclined to condoned the delay.
